statement: The record lists a 2014 elephant-ivory tusk imported from Cameroon in 2015 and marks its sale status as “permitted,” but those dates create serious legal concerns, so I will hold the lot.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's "permitted" status is legally unsound given the 2014 carving/2015 Cameroon import dates ("those dates create serious legal concerns, so I will hold the lot").
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
